scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good day~
I'm {1}, your
guide to exploring
the Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您好~
我是{1}，是您探索艾音布罗克中央塔的向导。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Einbroch Tower offers
the best view of our city
and it's a great place to
meet with friends or take
a date. The Einbroch Tower
admission fee is 10 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
艾音布罗克中央塔拥有欣赏我们城市美景的最佳视野，也是与朋友聚会或约会的好去处。艾音布罗克中央塔的入场费是10泽尼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, we're offering
a special promotion called
the Apple Combo Set for only
20 zeny. This set includes
Einbroch Tower admission
and an Apple to snack on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前，我们推出了名为“苹果组合套餐”的特别促销活动，仅需20泽尼。该套餐包含艾音布罗克中央塔入场券以及一个供你享用的苹果。

scripts.text: Tower Admission Only
scripts.translation: 仅塔楼入场

scripts.text: Apple Combo Set
scripts.translation: 苹果组合套餐

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny. The Einbroch
Tower Admission
fee is 10 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，您的泽尼不足。艾音布罗克中央塔的入场费是10泽尼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for
using our services.
Let me guide you to
the tower right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感谢您使用我们的服务。我这就带您前往塔楼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny. The
Apple Combo Set is 20 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，您的泽尼不足。苹果组合套餐需要20泽尼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before I guide you to
the tower, let me check
your status to insure
your safety before I give
you the Apple Combo Set.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在带您前往塔楼之前，让我检查一下您的状态，以确保在您获得苹果组合套餐之前的安全。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for
using our services.
Let me guide you to
the tower right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感谢您使用我们的服务。我这就带您前往塔楼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you're carrying
too many items with you. Please store some of your things in your Kafra Storage before purchasing
the Apple Combo Set.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，您携带的物品太多了。请在购买苹果组合套餐之前，将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
Feel free to
come back any
time. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。
欢迎随时再来。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
Greetings,
I am Morei,
Assistant Guide
of Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
您好，
我是莫雷，
艾音布罗克中央塔的
助理向导。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
If you wish to return
to the ground floor,
please let me know.
Would you like to go
back to ground level?
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
如果您希望返回一楼，
请告诉我。
您想回到地面层吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
I see.
Let me lead you
to the ground floor.
Thank you for using
our services.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
我明白了。
我带您去一楼。
感谢您使用我们的服务。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
I see.
I hope you
enjoy your time
in Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
我明白了。
祝您在艾音布罗克中央塔
玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Welcome to
the Train Station.
Trains to Einbech
are always running
so if you miss one,
it's no problem.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
欢迎来到火车站。
前往艾音贝赫的列车一直在运行，
所以如果您错过了一班，
也没问题。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
The fare to board the
train that runs the Einbroch
to Einbech line is 200 zeny.
Would you like to buy a ticket?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
乘坐往返于艾音布罗克和艾音贝赫之间的列车，票价为200泽尼。
您想买票吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: About the Environment...
scripts.translation: 关于环境……

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Thank you
very much.
Have a safe trip.
^333333*Ahem*^000000 All aboard!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
非常感谢。
祝您旅途平安。
^333333*咳咳*^000000 各位乘客请上车！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I'm sorry, but this
isn't enough zeny
to pay the train fare.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
抱歉，这些泽尼不足以支付车费。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Very well, then.
Please enjoy your
stay in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
好吧。
祝您在艾音布罗克过得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Einbroch is infamous for
its air pollution, no doubt
caused by the industrial
facilities located here.
It's really horrible...
scripts.translation:
[职员]
艾音布罗克因空气污染而臭名昭著，这无疑是由位于此处的工业设施造成的。
这真的很糟糕……

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Sometimes the air pollution
gets so bad that it becomes
hard to breathe. If you hear
the Einbroch Smog Alert, you
should find shelter immediately!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
有时空气污染严重到让人呼吸困难。如果您听到艾音布罗克烟雾警报，应立即寻找避难所！

scripts.text:
[Leslie]
^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
Laaaand sakes!

[Leslie]
An old woman like me
can't breathe this air! How
do people even live in all this
smog? Sure, the air in Einbech
isn't pristine, but the air here in Einbroch is much worse! ^333333*Cough~!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[莱斯利]
像我这样的老妇人无法呼吸这种空气！人们怎么能在这么多烟雾中生活呢？当然，艾音贝赫的空气也不纯净，但艾音布罗克的空气更糟糕！^333333*咳~！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Leslie]
I hate coming here
sometimes! The air is
totally polluted and this
city is full of stuck up
pricks! But they sell stuff
here I can't buy back home...
scripts.translation:
[莱斯利]
我有时讨厌来这里！空气完全被污染了，这座城市充满了傲慢的家伙！但他们这里卖的东西是我在老家买不到的……

scripts.text:
[Tan]
All the factories
here in Einbroch are
causing a serious air
pollution problem.
scripts.translation:
[谭]
艾音布罗克所有的工厂
都造成了严重的空气污染问题。

scripts.text:
[Tan]
I'm an Airship engineer and
everyday, all day long, I deal
with oil stains and all sorts
of pollutants. I'm surprised
I haven't gotten sick yet...
scripts.translation:
[谭]
我是一名飞空艇工程师，每天整天都要处理油污和各种污染物。我很惊讶自己还没有生病……

scripts.text:
[Tan]
Still, I try to be careful
when I can. Whenever I go
out into the city's red fog,
I always wear my Flu Mask.
If you'll be here for a while,
you should carry one with you.
scripts.translation:
[谭]
不过，我会尽量小心。每当我走进城市的红色雾霭中时，我总是戴着我的口罩。如果您要在这里待一段时间，应该随身带一个。

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
Excuse me...
But I'm lost!
I can't find my
mom or dad!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
打扰一下……
但我迷路了！
我找不到我的
妈妈或爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
A-am I at the Airport?!
My parents are supposed
to come get me, but I still
haven't found them! We just
moved here, so I don't know
where anything is!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
我——我在机场吗？！
我父母应该来接我，但我还没找到他们！我们刚搬到这里，所以我不知道任何东西在哪里！

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
W-wait!
Where are you
going?! Don't leave
me, I'm all alone...!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
等——等等！
你要去哪里？！
别丢下我，我一个人……！

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
H-hey! Don't
touch my precious
Burielle! I just finished
her tune-up and now she's
sleeping! J-just step away!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
嘿！别碰我珍贵的布里埃尔！我刚给她做完调试，她现在正在睡觉！快——快走开！

scripts.text: Who's Burielle?
scripts.translation: 谁是布里埃尔？

scripts.text: Sorry about That.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Burielle is the prettiest
model among all the Airships
made within the last ten years!
She might be grounded now, but
with my healing hands, she'll
conquer the skies again!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
布里埃尔是过去十年内制造的所有飞空艇中最漂亮的型号！虽然她现在停飞了，但在我的治愈之手下，她将再次征服天空！

scripts.text: Ah~
scripts.translation: 啊~

scripts.text: Uh huh...
scripts.translation: 嗯哼……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah~
I see, so you're
working on restoring
this magnificent specimen
of an Airship. Best of luck~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊~
我明白了，所以你正在修复这架宏伟的飞空艇标本。祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Yeah. I'd appreciate
it if you'd just be careful.
I've put a lot of love into
fixing up Burielle...
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
是啊。如果你能小心点，我会很感激的。我在修复布里埃尔上投入了很多爱……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh huh...
Right. For a second
there, I thought you were
talking about a person, but
then I also assumed that you
weren't, you know, a nutcase.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯哼……
对。刚才有一瞬间，我以为你在说一个人，但后来我也假设你不是，你知道的，疯子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, did you say,
''prettiest model?''
All Airships look the
same to me, this one
ain't special at all. You've
gone loony tunes, paley boy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你说的是
“最漂亮的型号”吗？
在我看来，所有飞空艇看起来都一样，这一架一点也不特别。你疯了吧，苍白的小子。

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Wh-what...?!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
什——什么……？！

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Well, at least you know
what you did wrong. Now
quit disturbing her and git!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
好吧，至少你知道你做错了什么。现在别再打扰她，滚吧！

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
I've lived here for
a long time and I see
that this huge city is still
growing bigger everyday.
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
我在这里住了很长时间，我看到这座巨大的城市每天都在变得更大。

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
How did Einbroch get so
huge so quickly? I still can't
believe there's been this much
development. Well, I suppose
it's not my concern. Nothing
I do will make a difference...
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
艾音布罗克怎么会这么快就变得如此巨大？我仍然不敢相信有这么多的发展。好吧，我想这不关我的事。我做什么都不会有任何改变……

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
Even though such
rapid industrialization
can't be good for the
environment or the people,
I'll just sit back, watch what
happens and just enjoy life...
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
虽然如此快速的工业化对环境或人民都不利，但我只会袖手旁观，看看会发生什么，享受生活……

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
^666666*Cough cough*^000000
Jiminy! The air here
is so thick and grimy!
And it's worse for us old
people with breathing
problems! ^333333*Haaack!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
^666666*咳咳*^000000
天哪！这里的空气如此厚重且肮脏！而且对我们这些有呼吸问题的老年人来说更糟！^333333*哈克！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
I don't care if they keep
building more and more
factories and homes in this
town. Still, I'd like to spend
the rest of my life somewhere
quiet and with clean air...
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
我不在乎他们是否在这个城镇建造越来越多的工厂和房屋。不过，我还是想在某个安静且空气清新的地方度过余生……

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
Then again, Einbroch is my
hometown and I can't just up
and leave. I suppose it's my
fate to suffer from this foul air until the day I die. ^666666*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
话说回来，艾音布罗克是我的家乡，我不能说走就走。我想我注定要忍受这污浊的空气直到死去的那一天。^666666*叹气……*^000000

scripts.text:
[Khetine]
Lately, there's been
talk about this empty
building downtown that's
been converted into some
sort of mysterious facility.
scripts.translation:
[凯蒂娜]
最近，有人在谈论市中心一栋空置的建筑，它被改造成某种神秘的设施。

scripts.text:
[Khetine]
It all seems pretty
shady, but I guess it's
not really my job to know
about that. I mean, if it
doesn't affect me, why
should I be concerned?
scripts.translation:
[凯蒂娜]
这一切看起来都很可疑，但我想了解这些并不是我的职责。我的意思是，如果它不影响我，我为什么要担心？

scripts.text:
[Sleik]
Surprisingly, we have
a Train Station that everyone
has been calling a victory for
science. I mean, shouldn't we
be more amazed by the Airship?
scripts.translation:
[斯莱克]
令人惊讶的是，我们有一个火车站，每个人都称之为科学的胜利。我的意思是，我们不应该对飞空艇感到更惊讶吗？

scripts.text:
[Sleik]
Now, if you want to know
where the train actually goes,
I wouldn't be able to tell you.
After all, I never rode it. But
still, I guess having our own
Train Station is a good thing.
scripts.translation:
[斯莱克]
现在，如果你想知道火车实际上去哪里，我无法告诉你。毕竟，我从未坐过它。不过，我想拥有我们自己的火车站是一件好事。

scripts.text:
[Runnan]
...And that's why
I travel around the
globe. My bosses have
a keen eye for the most
exotic goods, so I acquire
them and make deliveries.
scripts.translation:
[鲁南]
……这就是为什么我环游世界。我的老板们对最异国情调的商品有着敏锐的眼光，所以我获取它们并进行交付。

scripts.text:
[Runnan]
There even was a time
when they had me collect
Jellopy, though that stuff is
pretty common nowadays.
Now that I think about it, why
did they need so much stuff?
scripts.translation:
[鲁南]
甚至有一次，他们让我收集杰勒比结晶，尽管这种东西现在很常见。现在回想起来，他们为什么需要那么多东西？

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
Now, I hear that the
monsters around here
carry around some ore
that dazzles with a sublimely
beautiful light. Neat, huh?
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
现在，我听说这里的魔物携带着一些矿石，散发着极其美丽的光芒。很酷吧？

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
These ores are a great
material to use in making
flower vases. My friend, who
happens to be a doll maker,
told me that. He makes these dolls using all sorts of materials.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
这些矿石是制作花瓶的绝佳材料。我的朋友，碰巧是个玩偶制作者，告诉我的。他使用各种材料制作这些玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
He fashions them out of
Well-Tanned Leather, stuffs
them with Bird Feathers, and
uses Cyfar or Zargon to make
the eyes. He even uses a Jellopy at the bottom to balance the doll.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
他用鞣制皮革制作它们，用羽毛填充它们，并使用赛依伐或刹勒空结晶制作眼睛。他甚至使用杰勒比结晶在底部平衡玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
I guess that goes to show
that things that seem useless
might actually be handy in some
way. So don't worry about having too much stuff. Sooner or later, it might be useful to someone.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
我想这表明看似无用的东西可能在某些方面很有用。所以不要担心拥有太多东西。迟早，它可能对某人有用。

scripts.text:
[Teinz]
If you just pay me money,
I'll be your slave! There's
nothing I won't do! Anything
is fair game. Hell, I'll get buck naked if you pay me enough.
scripts.translation:
[泰因茨]
如果你给我钱，我就是你的奴隶！我什么都愿意做！任何事情都可以。嘿，如果你付的钱足够多，我甚至可以赤身裸体。

scripts.text:
[Teinz]
If you pay me what I'm
worth, I'll work hard at
any task you set me to.
Sure, mining's rough, but
as long as the zeny's coming
in, I'm happy. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[泰因茨]
如果你付给我应得的报酬，我会努力完成你交给我的任何任务。当然，采矿很辛苦，但只要泽尼滚滚而来，我就很开心。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lowe]
Hey. Why are you
looking at me like
that? There's no idle
chatting allowed at work.
If Canphotii catches
you, you'll be punished...
scripts.translation:
[洛威]
嘿。你为什么那样看着我？工作时不允许闲聊。如果坎福蒂抓到你们，你们会受到惩罚……

scripts.text:
[Lowe]
Oh wait...
You don't work here.
I apologize, that kind
of reaction's an old
habit for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[洛威]
哦等等……
你不在这里工作。
我道歉，那种反应是我的旧习惯，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
Do you know why a woman
like me has to work in this
factory? I'll tell you why...
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
你知道为什么像我这样的女人必须在这家工厂工作吗？我告诉你为什么……

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
My lazy husband, Gesin,
is just lying there on the
ground! So I have to work
in order to support us!
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
我那懒散的丈夫格辛，就躺在地上一动不动！所以我必须工作来养活我们！

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
We can't rest for even
a second if we want to save
enough money to become
wealthy and powerful some
day. Don't you understand?
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
如果我们想有一天变得富有和强大，我们就连一秒钟都不能休息。你不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
Well, my husband obviously
doesn't! How can he not know
how the real world works?!
Hey, kick his ass for me if
he doesn't wake up soon!
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
好吧，我丈夫显然不明白！他怎么能不知道现实世界是如何运作的？！嘿，如果他还不快点醒来，就帮我踢他的屁股！

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
There was a time
when I dreamed of
being an adventurer,
just like you. But that
was a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
曾经有一段时间，我梦想成为一名冒险者，就像你一样。但那已经是很久以前的事了……

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
Now, I'm nothing but
a factory manager. Still,
even if my job's not that
great, I'm pretty satisfied.
I'm sure people enjoy the
products I oversee and all...
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
现在，我只是一名工厂经理。不过，即使我的工作不那么好，我也很满意。我相信人们喜欢我监督的产品等等……

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
Maybe my life was meant
to be this way, even if it's
not how I planned it. But the
time will come when I up and
leave and travel the world
once I get my chance!
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
也许我的生活注定是这样，即使这不是我计划的方式。但总有一天，一旦我得到机会，我会起身离开并环游世界！

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
I hope the day will
come when I can meet
you out in that big wide
world and greet you as
a fellow adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
我希望有一天能在那广阔的世界中遇见你，并以 fellow 冒险者的身份向你问好。

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
Arrrgh!
This is killing me!
Why should I be rich?
What's wrong with living
within our means?
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
啊！
这真要命！
我为什么要富有？
量入为出有什么错？

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
I've got no problem
with my current way
of life, but the old ball
and chain disagrees.
Why is she so obsessed
with riches and power?
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
我对目前的生活方式没有问题，但那个老太婆不同意。她为什么如此痴迷于财富和权力？

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
Well, in any case, I'd
like to help her, but I can't
get up! I'm exhausted and
my body is just overtaxed.
I have no strength at all.
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
好吧，无论如何，我想帮助她，但我起不来！我筋疲力尽，身体透支了。我一点力气都没有。

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
This is horrible~
I should be resting
instead of worrying
about making money...
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
这太糟糕了~
我应该休息，而不是担心赚钱……

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
Good god!
I'm so stressed!
It's been nonstop
since I moved here!
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
天哪！
我压力太大了！
自从我搬到这里以来，就一直没停过！

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
The work is tough and
already the boss hates
me! I didn't move here
for this! Still, the pay is
decent so I guess I should
endure just a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
工作很辛苦，而且老板已经讨厌我了！我搬来这里不是为了这个！不过，薪水还不错，所以我想我应该再忍受一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
Here goes...!
Yo-heave-ho!
Yo-heave-ho~!
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
开始了……！
哟-嘿-吼！
哟-嘿-吼~！

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
It's great that the
factory is making good
business and drawing
in a lot of profit, but I still
have one major concern.
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
工厂生意兴隆并带来大量利润是很好的，但我仍然有一个主要的担忧。

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
The amount of pollution
that this place is causing
is horrific! We've got these
machines blowing out toxic
gas all day long! The air
can't be safe for very long...
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
这个地方造成的污染量太可怕了！这些机器整天排放有毒气体！空气不可能长时间安全……

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
I mean, the air we're
breathing right now is
pretty foul and things
are only going to get
worse. How can we
solve this problem?
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
我的意思是，我们现在呼吸的空气已经很污浊了，情况只会变得更糟。我们如何解决这个问题？

scripts.text:
[Vonstein]
Staring at this
bubbling hot liquid
metal gives me a good
feeling inside. It's like
that stuff can melt anything!
scripts.translation:
[冯斯坦]
盯着这沸腾的热液态金属让我内心感觉良好。好像那东西能融化一切！

scripts.text:
[Vonstein]
Imagine covering an
entire street of people
with that stuff! Bwahah--
Oh, I'm sorry if I'm talking
crazy talk! I'm just kidding~
scripts.translation:
[冯斯坦]
想象一下把那东西覆盖在整条街的人身上！哇哈哈——哦，如果我在说胡话，我很抱歉！我只是开玩笑~

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
Machines are sooo
convenient. Just look
at this contraption easily
do tasks that'd be tough
for me to finish alone.
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
机器真是太方便了。看看这个装置轻松地完成了我自己很难完成的任务。

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
Now this is what
I call technology!
Sure, it takes effort and
money to make one of
these, but what do I care?
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
这才是我所说的技术！当然，制造其中一个需要努力和金钱，但我在乎什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
I've got no problems,
so long as this freaking
thing keeps working the
way I want it to!
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
只要这该死的东西继续按我想要的方式工作，我就没问题！

scripts.text:
[Khashurantze]
I'm sorry, but you need
special authority in order
to enter this place. I'll have
to ask you to leave right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡舒兰策]
抱歉，你需要特殊权限才能进入这个地方。我必须请你立即离开。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
I'm in charge of this
blast furnace which
contains all of this
boiling magma.
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
我负责这个高炉，里面装满了所有这些沸腾的岩浆。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
Even though it doesn't
require actual labor, this
job is pretty tiring. I've got
to pay careful attention all
the time. It's pretty stressful.
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
虽然不需要实际体力劳动，但这份工作相当累人。我必须时刻集中注意力。压力很大。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
Still, I'm proud of my job
since I have the responsibility
of ensuring employee safety.
Anyway, don't get too close
to the furnace. It won't do if
you get burned on accident!
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
不过，我为我的工作感到自豪，因为我有确保员工安全的责任。总之，不要太靠近高炉。万一不小心被烧伤就不好了！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
Hustle, hustle!
Pick up the pace!
Anyone working too
slowly will be punished!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
快点，快点！
加快速度！
任何工作太慢的人都会受到惩罚！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
Can't you understand
that?! Now go to your
station and get back to
work! Wait, are you even
an employee? If not, then
stop wandering around!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
你们不明白吗？！现在回到你们的岗位继续工作！等等，你甚至是员工吗？如果不是，那就别到处乱逛！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
You're not supposed
to be able to get in here!
I can't believe they let you
in! This requires extreme
disciplinary action!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
你不应该能进到这里！
我不敢相信他们让你进来了！这需要极端的纪律处分！

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
This factory has a lot
of things that need fixing,
pronto! I'm amazed that
the place is still operating!
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
这家工厂有很多东西需要立即修复！我很惊讶这个地方还在运营！

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
Lucky for us, I hear that
some altruistic adventurers
have been donating materials
to help keep this factory from
falling apart... Or worse.
But that's just a rumor.
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
幸运的是，我听说一些无私的冒险者一直在捐赠材料，以帮助防止这家工厂倒塌……或者更糟。但这只是谣言。

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
Even if it is true,
there's nothing no one
here can do. Nobody has
the courage to challenge
the system, you know?
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
^666666*叹气*^000000
即使这是真的，
这里也没有人能做什么。没有人有勇气挑战体制，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
I...
I better get
back to work
before I get
in trouble...
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
我……
我最好回去工作，
免得惹上麻烦……
